scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the printed model, next-generation reproduction number, parameter Tables 3 and 4, initial-data Table 5, numerical method, and fitted trajectory. The model-equation and parameter-table pages were visually inspected. A full-text count-based COVID-19 model using explicit S/N normalization was inspected for incidence-convention comparison. The bundled exact checker verifies all arithmetic and the population-factor identity. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result identifies an internal parameter-normalization inconsistency. It does not determine which incidence convention was used in unavailable simulation code, does not refit the South African data, and does not transfer the source's dynamical theorems automatically to a frequency-dependent repair.

title: A missing population normalization separates the printed SARS-CoV-2 model from its fitted reproduction numbers
